target_customer: Mid-sized and large Brazilian companies in consumer goods, retail and services running market expansion and B2B prospecting
problem: Sales and marketing teams cannot easily use geolocated market data without data scientists; Datlo provides a geointelligence platform to find customers, channels and expansion sites.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus data enrichment (DaaS) and audience products
product_category: Geointelligence and location analytics for go-to-market

founders.name: Mateus Felini
education: Geography degree (completed 2017) specializing in remote sensing and geoprocessing, per a news summary; master's in geography per the same source
founders.background_notes: Education taken from a search summary of Brazilian press; the article was not opened.

founders.name: Raisa Spagnol
founders.background_notes: Described as having a technology background and meeting Felini at a Maringa accelerator, per a search summary.

competitors.name: Geofusion
competitors.what: Brazilian geomarketing company, says it has led the Brazilian geomarketing market for more than 26 years

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining 130 plus data sources into map based analytics and recommendation models; standard data engineering with some geospatial depth.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregated geolocated datasets on 60 million companies per the site create some data advantage; an established incumbent already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Geofusion became part of Cortex in 2022 per its page; no source found of it copying Datlo.

market_need_then: Brazilian consumer goods and retail firms needed local market data for expansion and prospecting; YC lists SaaS, GIS and B2B.

identity.voice_and_tone: Business focused, positioned on shortening the distance between companies and consumers

branding.community_and_virality: Press in Exame and Canaltech per its site; customers such as Shell, Raizen, Nestle and Unimed are claimed.

brand_strength.rationale: Name resembles Datto or data brands, and I found no brand press or name origin source.

outcome_analysis: Datlo grew from a Maringa geography based startup to a company claiming about 60 staff and large Brazilian customers. Its public funding is limited to YC and a May 2025 seed extension of about 4 million reais led by Hiker Ventures, suggesting capital efficient growth. No exit or shutdown found.
notes: Seed extension R$ 4 million reported by startups.com.br and Startupi, with LatamList giving 710K USD on May 14, 2025; amount left in reais so amount_usd is null. Datlo's site says 125K USD from Y Combinator in 2021, which is not a recorded round. A 2022 headline about a Saudi investor (ANBA) was not opened, so not recorded. Founding year conflicts: 2018, 2019 or 2021 by source. Geofusion has no date for its competitor entry; it is a market incumbent whose tenure implies it existed before the batch.
